name: Németkér (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, white at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Németkér (a crowned blue shield with a white ploughshare, supported by two yellow lions) above the name NÉMETKÉR in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Németkér arms with crown and lion supporters
